title: Quarterly assortment review — 214 active SKUs
narrative: Grouped by destination so each system gets one write. Markdown and sourcing hand off as cards; Planner and the channels take direct pushes with a diff on every line.
status_note: Execute · 0 of 4 destinations pushed · 14 line items staged

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

targets.name: Markdown & recovery
targets.meta: 12 exit SKUs · $27K at cost · 3 recovery cards

items.name: Markdown card MD-3312
items.detail: Ladder-eligible exits with more than 8 weeks of cover. Opens as a clearance cohort in the markdown story with the storage-cost clock already running.

items.name: Liquidation quote request
items.detail: Below the ladder recovery floor at current velocity. Two quotes already on file at 22% and 27% of cost.

items.name: Donation routing
items.detail: Novelty egg cups and chalkboard labels — recovery value under the $8.40 handling floor, tax value beats liquidation.

targets.name: Planner
targets.meta: 34 SKUs · stop-buy and depth flags · 3 open POs

items.name: Stop-buy flags
items.detail: No further replenishment on the exit set. Flags sit ahead of the next planning run so nothing re-enters the buy sheet.

items.name: Depth reduction to 4 weeks cover
items.detail: Buy depth cut on the Supporting tail. Ranging is untouched, so no channel goes dark.

items.name: Open PO cancellations
items.detail: PO-88412, PO-88437 and PO-88501 carry exit SKUs inside their cancel window (closes in 6, 9 and 11 days). Cancel requests go with the flags.

targets.name: Channel ranging updates
targets.meta: 4 channels · every change diffed before push

items.name: Shopify · collections and nav
items.detail: Exit SKUs leave 4 collections, gap fills land as drafts in Cookware and Storage, two nav facets recount.

items.name: Amazon · listing status
items.detail: Exits move to Inactive with the ASIN kept so review history survives. Grow SKUs get max-order-quantity raised.

items.name: Walmart · item flags
items.detail: Exits unpublish, reduce set flags to limited-depth, gap fills open as setup-pending until the sourcing brief lands.

items.name: Faire · wholesale sheet
items.detail: Exit lines drop off the wholesale assortment sheet at the next catalogue refresh, 3 grow SKUs move to the front page.

targets.name: Gap fills → sourcing
targets.meta: 4 new lines · $6K test buy · sourcing brief per line

items.name: Enamel Dutch oven 5.5qt
items.detail: Ranged by 4 of 5 rivals. Brief carries the demand estimate, target landed cost and the two suppliers Prospector already shortlisted.

items.name: Glass storage 12-pc set
items.detail: Ranged by all 5 rivals and the largest single gap in the set. Needs a packaging spec before the first buy.

items.name: Ceramic knife block
items.detail: Bundles with the existing Alder knife line. Test quantity only until the 60-day read.

items.name: Silicone bakeware set

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, every quarter comes back through this four-step flow.
